hooks.name: Python change: run loop guard when the change set is complete
hooks.description: Reminds the agent to run the tracked regression suite after Python changes, including edits outside spec tasks.

action.prompt: A Python file changed. When the current change set is complete (not after every intermediate file), run `python .kiro/scripts/loop_guard.py` and read any failure before making another change. If it prints ESCALATE, stop and hand over to the human.
